answer: Make every agent identity post a slashable stake bond locked in a transparent escrow, clear as crystal, before it can transact; the bond fee rises steeply with each extra identity funded from the same source. Each agent carries a signed work-history credential — its quill — that earns fee discounts as it completes honest jobs. If an identity is caught attesting fake work, its bond is slashed and its credential burned, so a marble army of sock puppets costs real money per head while honest agents pay almost nothing once proven.
